prompt: Add a new imperative command to the macOS Paper Callout view manager in packages/agentic/native-core. Plan the change.

assertions.description: Implements the Paper manager method in Swift and declares it with RCT_EXTERN_METHOD rather than importing the generated Swift header into the registration file.
Plans macOS Paper validation with the --paper Storybook flag, because macOS commands default to Fabric, and reports untested renderers explicitly.
